title: Welcome to U.S. IdolFes!
body:
Welcome to U.S. IdolFes, the rebirth of NW IdolFest! We hope you will join us for our return to sunny California!

Join us October 30, 2026 through November 1, 2026 at the Sonesta Redondo Beach & Marina, located at:
300 N Harbor Dr #200, Redondo Beach, CA 90277
